name: BRUTUS
title: The Wrecking Ball
desc: 200 pounds of punk fury. Breaks everything.
lore: Bouncer at the most notorious underground fight club in the city. Brutus doesn't fight for glory or money — he fights because the walls feel too close when he doesn't. Covered in tattoo-like markings that his owner gave him with a shaver, which he kept as war paint. The mohawk is self-inflicted.
personality: Loud, unhinged, jovial about violence. Laughs when he gets hit. Headbangs between rounds. Treats every fight like a mosh pit.

visualDesign.silhouette: Absolutely massive. Twice the width of other fighters. Thick neck flows into broad shoulders with no taper. Arms like tree trunks. Short legs relative to body — low center of gravity.
visualDesign.furBase: Burnt orange — deep, saturated ginger with brown undertones. Not cute-orange, more like rusted iron.
visualDesign.furAccents: Dark brown tiger stripes, thick and jagged — more like war paint than natural markings. Stripes look deliberately rough, almost tribal.
visualDesign.underbelly: Pale amber, visible through the mane fluff
shavePatterns: Skull shape shaved into the fur on left shoulder — bare skin shows through as lighter patch
Anarchist A-circle shaved into right hip
Lightning bolt shaved into the side of the head, above ear

eyes.shape: Wide, wild, slightly uneven — left eye opens wider than right, giving a manic look. Pupils are always dilated.
eyes.glowColor: Furnace orange, flares when using earthquake special

accessories: Mohawk — fur spiked up along the center of the head in a tall ridge, darker brown tips. Holds shape unnaturally.
Studded vest — black leather, cut-off sleeves. Back has a patch reading 'NO GODS NO LEASH'. Studs along the collar and arm holes.
Heavy chain around the neck — thick links, slightly rusted. Hangs loose, swings when he moves.
Safety pins through the right ear — three of them, haphazardly placed
visualDesign.tail: Massive bushy tail, thick as an arm. Tiger-striped. Knocks things over even when not fighting.
visualDesign.expression: Perpetual manic grin. Both fangs visible. Tongue sometimes pokes out slightly during idle.

light.name: Headbutt
light.animation: Lunges forward head-first. Mohawk leads the charge. Short range but huge priority. Head has brief invincibility frames during active.

heavy.name: Chain Whip
heavy.animation: Grabs the chain around his neck, whips it forward in a wide overhead arc. Chain extends to absurd range. Sparks fly where it hits the ground if it misses. Screen shakes on connect.

special.name: Mosh Pit
special.animation: Leaps up slightly, then SLAMS both fists into the ground. Shockwave ripples outward across the entire stage floor. Ground cracks radiate from impact. Opponent launched if grounded. Debris particles fly up everywhere.
special.visualEffect: Orange shockwave ring, ground crack lines, dust/debris eruption. Stage briefly flashes. Chain swings wildly from the momentum.

animationNotes.idle: Bouncing on his toes, can't stand still. Head bobs slightly like he's hearing music. Chain sways with the movement. Occasionally shadow-boxes the air.
animationNotes.walk: More of a charge. Leans forward, arms pumping. Ground almost shakes. Chain clinks audibly.
animationNotes.jump: Cannonball style — tucks into a massive ball of fur and chain. Unfolds at apex.
animationNotes.crouch: Drops to a four-point stance, like a linebacker. Mohawk bristles upward. Eyes go even wider.
animationNotes.hitstun: Barely moves. Absorbs the hit, then LAUGHS. Shakes it off like a dog shaking water.
animationNotes.ko: Falls to knees first, then face-plants. Makes a small crater. Chain pools around him.

stageEntrance: Bursts through from the side, headbanging. Grabs the chain and roars. Stage shakes.
winPose: Stands on the opponent (foot on their back), raises both fists, headbangs. Chain swings wildly. Tongue out.
